integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and a standard-library diagnostic program are supplied. Numerical checks alone are not proofs of asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: Two-point Poisson-reset Brownian search on an absorbing half-line; asymptotic survival exponent optimized before L tends to infinity. The finite-distance coexistence classification is local near the identified critical weight. No claim about mean-first-passage optimization or finite-time performance.
title: A sparse-reset first-order transition in optimal Brownian survival decay
